answer: Verification needs work an attacker cannot bulk-solve. Anchor each epoch's difficulty to a public randomness beacon: once the beacon publishes, every agent must commit a proof-of-work nonce stamped with that seed before its attestation counts. The seed is unpredictable and one-shot, so a farm cannot precompute answers; it must rent compute exactly when the beacon fires and burn capital while idle, so a thousand clones cost a thousand burst rentals. Honest agents amortize one stake across a haven of epochs; a farm pays fleet size times burst cost times epochs, and replay is a river run dry.
